title: Russian Nuclear Ballistic Missile Submarines Are Now Cocooned In Nets
summary: Russian naval bases are implementing new defensive measures, including cocooning nuclear ballistic missile submarines in protective nets. This action is likely a response to growing threats from uncrewed systems. These measures are being observed across various Russian naval facilities.

title: Army opens ranges in US, Morocco to speed interceptor testing, development
summary: The U.S. Army is opening new testing ranges in the U.S. and Morocco to accelerate the development and testing of interceptor munitions. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll stated the goal is to allow companies with internally funded munitions to access these ranges within 30 days of a request, streamlining the development process.

summary: A volunteer Bitcoin security group, the 'Bitcoin Red Team,' claims its AI-powered efforts have uncovered critical exploits across core Bitcoin projects. The team has scanned 150 Bitcoin repositories, disclosed over a dozen vulnerabilities, and is developing an open-source AI platform to automate software security reviews for the ecosystem.

title: US Senate to vote on advancing CLARITY Act in September after Thune files cloture
summary: The US Senate is set to vote in September on advancing the CLARITY Act, a key piece of crypto market structure legislation. Senate Majority Leader John Thune's procedural move puts the bill back on track. Lawmakers continue negotiations over ethics and stablecoin provisions.

title: Treasury Sanctions Crypto Exchanges It Says Laundered Millions for Iran
summary: The U.S. Treasury has sanctioned two cryptocurrency exchanges it alleges laundered millions of dollars for Iran's Revolutionary Guard. The named entities include a Georgia- and UAE-based operator and an Iran-based platform. This action is part of a broader effort to combat illicit finance.

title: US court backs Bybit’s bid to trace funds from $1.5B North Korea hack
summary: A US court has supported Bybit's request for expedited discovery to trace funds from a $1.5 billion hack attributed to North Korea. This ruling allows the exchange to seek account identities, balances, and transaction histories from platforms operating in the US. This aids in the recovery of stolen assets.

summary: New amendments to the XRP Ledger are being proposed, specifically targeting the integration of $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets. These updates aim to enhance the ledger's capabilities for traditional financial asset tokenization and broader institutional adoption.

title: Iran’s oil exports stall and Kharg Island idles under US blockade
summary: Iran's oil exports have reportedly stalled, and Kharg Island, a major oil terminal, is idling due to a US blockade. This naval interdiction appears to be effectively halting the transport of Iranian crude oil.

title: U.S. economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July
summary: The US economy unexpectedly lost 23,000 jobs in July, contrary to projections that anticipated an increase of 83,000 nonfarm payrolls and a steady unemployment rate. This significant deviation from forecasts indicates a weaker-than-expected labor market.
